pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-08.png with Read. It loaded and I viewed it. Layout: two top panels, a wide middle panel, and a tall wide bottom panel.
pages.observation: How I read it: (1) Top left: the caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' with ravi. (2) Top right: the teal label 'WELBUK VISION', a specialist, and the caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' (3) Middle: the teal label 'WELBUK VISION' again, the caption 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.', then ravi, partner and child. (4) Bottom: meera, ananya and ravi at the top, the teal label 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health' at top right, and finally the caption 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.' at bottom left. Issues: The voice of 'us' in panel 1 is unclear. Sitting next to Ravi it reads as his thought, but the other captions are an impersonal narrator. 'Tomorrow' and 'may' mark a future or hypothetical scene, but panels 2 and 3 do not say whether they are imagined or real. A specialist, Ravi's partner and a child appear for the first time with no introduction, so the reader must guess they are Ravi's family. 'WELBUK VISION' repeats in two consecutive panels, which is redundant. In panel 4 the teal label butts against the ravi face box and ravi's label is cut to 'rav', so the drawn screen could cover Ravi's face. Moving the label down or Ravi left is suggested. Panel 4 has a large empty middle between the label at top right and the caption at bottom left. The closing tagline still reads last. The ending reads as a brand tagline more than a resolution of Ravi's visit.
